{{recipe}}

These steaks, seasoned with spices and herbs, will save you money that you might have used to go to a steakhouse.
[[Category:Recipes using beef loin]]
[[Category:Recipes using rosemary]]
[[Category:Recipes using thyme]]
[[Category:Grilled recipes]]
[[Category:Main course recipes]]
== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24–32 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] strip steaks, 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tsp coarsely-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 ½ tsp dried [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 2 tsp dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
* Extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine seasonings. Set aside.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] steaks liberally with olive oil. Rub each side of steaks with seasoning mixture. Leave at room temperature for 30–45 minutes before continuing.
#Prepare [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] for indirect heating, high on one side, medium on the other. Add steaks to high part of grill and cook 1 ¼ minutes. Rotate 90 degrees and cook for another 1 ¼ minutes. Flip and repeat one more time.
#Move steaks to medium heat and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 140°F for medium-rare.
#Remove to a plate and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest 7–10 minutes.
#[[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] steaks thinly across the grain on a bias. Serve warm.
